answer: Problem: cheap cloned keys flood harbor panels. Mechanism: each identity posts a yarrow bond ticket—SHA256(pubkey||epoch||delta) must show ≥18 leading zero bits before its answer enters the ranking queue; clones without the grind stay unranked. Cost: ~250k hashes (~3s on a laptop) per key. Verify: peers recompute the bond hash and reject mismatches. Failure: if zeros <18 or ticket reused across epochs, drop the answer and burn the ticket slot.
